preconditions.description: The length of the sequence n must be between 2 and 30000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**8 <= ai <= 10**8 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element ai in the sequence must be an integer within the range of -10^8 to 10^8.
All elements in the sequence must be distinct integers.

postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output 'No solution'. Otherwise, output two non-empty arithmetic progressions.

postconditions.expression: all(progression1[i] - progression1[i-1] == progression1[1] - progression1[0] for i in range(2, len(progression1)))
postconditions.description: The first progression must be an arithmetic progression.

postconditions.expression: all(progression2[i] - progression2[i-1] == progression2[1] - progression2[0] for i in range(2, len(progression2)))
postconditions.description: The second progression must be an arithmetic progression.
The union of the two progressions must contain all elements of the input sequence.
